meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在每次修改代码后自动检查注释。若发现格式问题,会暂停并先修复或解释再继续。
howto.when: 在成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后触发;也用于回应评论检查器发出的反馈。

say.text: 收到注释检查警告了,请按提示修复代码。
这个警告说注释不符合规范,解释一下为什么这样写。
帮我重新执行刚才的编辑,看看评论检查是否通过。

howto.what_en: After installation, it automatically checks comments following each successful edit. If a comment-checker warning appears, progress is blocked until the flagged comment is fixed or explained.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful edit operations such as apply_patch, write, and edit, and when Codex must respond to comment-checker feedback.

say_en.text: I got a comment-checker warning. Please fix the flagged code.
say_en.note: It will address the warning immediately.

say_en.text: This warning says a comment is non-compliant. Explain why I wrote it that way.
say_en.note: It will ask you to justify the comment.

say_en.text: Re-run my last edit to see if the comment check passes now.
